name: WebAV
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: WebCodecs-based browser SDK: clip, composite and encode MP4 in the page
summary: Bilibili's browser SDK on WebCodecs: av-cliper decodes clips and sprites and a Combinator composites them to an MP4 stream, av-canvas adds an interactive editor and av-recorder records MediaStreams. Driven from JavaScript in Chrome, Edge or Electron; output is MP4. Strength is a ready compositing layer over raw WebCodecs.
use_when: Sprite-layered MP4 composition entirely in the browser, with a ready editor canvas
avoid_when: Encode and mux from canvas frames: Mediabunny, lighter and server-capable
Programmatic editing library: Diffusion Studio Core
Anything FFmpeg can do: FFmpeg (native) or FFmpeg.wasm

assessment.rationale: Active (1.2.8, Jan 2026) but duplicates Mediabunny and Diffusion Studio Core for browser composition and encoding, and needs a WebCodecs browser (no Node route).

notes: 2026-10-26: npm metadata lists no licence field, MIT from the repository page; Node support not mentioned in the README.
